source.description: Where the dossier comes from: ``tk`` the Tweede Kamer's data, ``eerstekamer`` written from the papers of the Eerste Kamer because the Tweede Kamer's data has none (its OData begins about 2005), with the title they give (``title_source`` ``eerstekamer``) and no kind, phases or procedure of the Tweede Kamer. A dossier without one in the graph (written before this field) is ``tk``: only those of the Eerste Kamer's papers carry ``eerstekamer``.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: ``Zaak.Soort`` as the Kamer writes it: ``Wetgeving``, ``Initiatiefwetgeving``, ``Begroting``, ``Verdrag``, ``Initiatiefnota``, ``PKB/Structuurvisie``; null for none.

kind_basis.title: Kind Basis
kind_basis.description: ``case``: a zaak of the dossier gives the kind; null without a kind.

phases.title: Phases
phases.description: Of a ``Wetgeving``, ``Initiatiefwetgeving`` or ``Begroting``: every phase of the bar in order; null for another kind.

current_phase.title: Current Phase
current_phase.description: The furthest done phase in the order of ``phases`` (not the one with the latest date: the Kamer may date a paper by the day it was received); null for none.

opened_on.title: Opened On
opened_on.description: The day it opened, as the Kamer dates its papers: of nr. 1 of its own numbering, else of its Koninklijke boodschap, else of its first paper or activity (``opened_on_basis``).

submitted_on_tk.title: Submitted On Tk
submitted_on_tk.description: The day the bill was submitted to the Tweede Kamer, as it dates it: the ``Zaak.GestartOp`` of the dossier's own zaak of a bill (``Wetgeving``, ``Initiatiefwetgeving``, ``Begroting``); null for another dossier.

last_activity.title: Last Activity
last_activity.description: The day of its newest paper, activity that took place (not one only planned, cancelled or moved) or decision, as the Kamer dates them; null for none. ``sort=last_activity`` lists the dossiers by it, newest first.

ministry.description: The ministry (``GET /api/ministries``) of the bewindspersoon who signed the earliest signed document of the dossier first; null for an initiative or when nobody in government or parliament signed first.

initiative.title: Initiative
initiative.description: True when a Kamerlid signed the earliest signed document first, false when a bewindspersoon did, null when neither did.

cabinet.title: Cabinet
cabinet.description: The key of the cabinet in office when that document was signed.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

DossierSummaryDTO.title: DossierSummaryDTO
DossierSummaryDTO.description:
A dossier in a list.

``kind`` is what the dossier is, as the Tweede Kamer names it: the ``Zaak.Soort`` of
the zaak that is the dossier itself (``Wetgeving``, ``Initiatiefwetgeving``,
``Begroting``, ``Verdrag``, ``Initiatiefnota``, ``PKB/Structuurvisie``); null without
one ("zonder soort": no kind is made up from its papers). ``kind_basis`` is ``case``
with a kind. A bill (``Wetgeving``, ``Initiatiefwetgeving``, ``Begroting``) has
``phases``: every phase of the curated list in its order, each done when a paper, an
activity or a decision of the Kamer marks it; ``current_phase`` is the furthest done
phase in that order. A closed dossier has an ``outcome``: ``aangenomen`` (its law was
published, or the Eerste Kamer adopted it) or ``verworpen`` (a chamber voted the bill
down); ``tk_decision`` is the last decision of the Tweede Kamer on the bill and
``ek_outcome`` its outcome in the Eerste Kamer.

DossierTimelineResponse.title: DossierTimelineResponse
DossierTimelineResponse.description: Everything that happened in a dossier, in date order.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Of an article of a protocol, its number (`1`); else null.

combined_with.title: Combined With
combined_with.description: The article it is taken together with (`8` of `13+8`).

aspect.title: Aspect
aspect.description: The aspect, when HUDOC names one.

text.title: Text
text.description: As HUDOC writes it: "No violation of Article 8 - …".

EchrFindingDTO.title: EchrFindingDTO
EchrFindingDTO.description: What the ECHR found on one article (``core/echr_findings.py``).

paragraph_id.title: Paragraph Id
paragraph_id.description: The paragraph, as `paragraph_id` of `/api/judgments/{ecli}`; of a footnote the paragraph that refers to it.

paragraph_number.title: Paragraph Number
paragraph_number.description: Its printed number (`5.3`), null when it has none.

footnote.title: Footnote
footnote.description: The label of the footnote it stands in, null in the paragraph itself.

EdgePassage.title: EdgePassage
EdgePassage.description: A place where a judgment cites, as the edge keeps it: to show without the judgment.

EdgeStatsDTO.title: EdgeStatsDTO
EdgeStatsDTO.description: Edge counts: total and per relation type.

EkBillSourceDTO.title: EkBillSourceDTO
EkBillSourceDTO.description: The page of the bill on eerstekamer.nl.

faction_id.title: Faction Id
faction_id.description: Null for a faction gone before the composition was first read (no node; its votes are not in the graph).

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: The last day, inclusive; null while they sit in it.

EkFactionMembershipDTO.title: EkFactionMembershipDTO
EkFactionMembershipDTO.description:
One stretch of a member's membership of a faction of the Eerste Kamer, as their page
on eerstekamer.nl says it (``normalize eerstekamer-persons``).

dossiers.title: Dossiers
dossiers.description: The names of ``dossier_numbers``, in their order: ``number``, ``short_title``, ``title`` as ``/api/dossiers`` gives them.

bill_decision.title: Bill Decision
bill_decision.description: Whether it is the vote that decided the bill (else a vote on a motion on it).

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: As the list of the Eerste Kamer names the faction's vote.

EkFactionVoteDTO.title: EkFactionVoteDTO
EkFactionVoteDTO.description: How a faction of the Eerste Kamer voted on one vote of its list.

total.title: Total
total.description: The votes that name the faction.

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: Per choice (``voor``, ``tegen``, ``aantekening gevraagd``), over every vote that names the faction.

EkFactionVotesResponse.title: EkFactionVotesResponse
EkFactionVotesResponse.description: The votes of a faction of the Eerste Kamer, newest first.

name.title: Name
name.description: As the Kamer writes it: mr. B.O. Dittrich.

seniority_days.title: Seniority Days
seniority_days.description: ``Anciënniteit``: the days served in the Eerste Kamer, earlier terms included; no start date.

seat.description: Where they sit in the plenary hall, as Wie zit waar on eerstekamer.nl draws it; null when it places them nowhere.

observed_from.title: Observed From
observed_from.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day a snapshot of eerstekamer.nl first showed it (not the day it began: the site gives no start as data); null for the Tweede Kamer.

observed_until.title: Observed Until
observed_until.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day of the first snapshot that no longer showed it (not the day it ended); null while it is shown.

EkMembershipDTO.title: EkMembershipDTO
EkMembershipDTO.description: A member's seat in the Eerste Kamer, as eerstekamer.nl shows it.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: As the Eerste Kamer shows it.

method.title: Method
method.description: How it was decided, as the report names it: ``Hamerstuk``, ``Stemming bij zitten en opstaan, aangenomen``, ``Hoofdelijke stemming, verworpen``; null for a rejection known from the list of rejected bills alone (before June 2015).

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: The page it was taken over from: the report of the vote, or the list of rejected bills.

retrieved_on.title: Retrieved On
retrieved_on.description: The day it was taken over.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: The source to name with it (``EK_ATTRIBUTION``), with ``source_url`` and ``retrieved_on``: the terms of eerstekamer.nl allow reuse with the source and the day it was taken over.

EkOutcomeDTO.title: EkOutcomeDTO
EkOutcomeDTO.description: The outcome of the bill of a dossier in the Eerste Kamer, as eerstekamer.nl gives it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: As the page names it: ``verslag``, ``stemming (hamerstuk)``.

number.title: Number
number.description: As the page writes it: ``EK, B``, ``TK, 2``; null for none.

EkPaperDTO.title: EkPaperDTO
EkPaperDTO.description: A paper of a step of a bill, as the page of the Eerste Kamer lists it.

composition_date.title: Composition Date
composition_date.description: The day of the composition shown: the snapshot it was last seen in (``stand``).

data_since.title: Data Since
data_since.description: The day of the first snapshot the graph holds: nothing before it is known.

EkSourceDTO.title: EkSourceDTO
EkSourceDTO.description: Where something of the Eerste Kamer was taken over from, to name with it.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: ``Schriftelijke voorbereiding``, ``Plenair``, ``Afkondiging``; null for the first step, in the Tweede Kamer.

house.title: House
house.description: ``Tweede Kamer``, ``Eerste Kamer``, ``Staatsblad(en)``; null where the page names none (the plenary step of the Eerste Kamer).

state.title: State
state.description: As the page marks it: ``vol`` (it drew the step full: done), ``geblokt`` (the step the bill is in), ``leeg`` (not reached).

EkStepDTO.title: EkStepDTO
EkStepDTO.description: A step of the progress of a bill, as the page of the Eerste Kamer shows it.

instrument.description: The other end: the EU act for `implements`, the national regulation for `implemented_by`.

bases.title: Bases
bases.description: What an `IMPLEMENTS` edge rests on: `national_implementing_measure` (EUR-Lex) and/or `considerans`; empty for `REFERS_TO`.

source.title: Source
source.description: The pipeline that wrote the edge (`bwb-implements`).

via.title: Via
via.description: The national implementing measures EUR-Lex lists for the act through which this instrument implements it (`national_implementing_measure`): a law that changed it to implement the act, or its own enacting publication. Empty for `considerans` alone and for `REFERS_TO`.

EuLinkDTO.title: EuLinkDTO
EuLinkDTO.description:
An `IMPLEMENTS` or `REFERS_TO` edge between a national instrument and an EU act.

`IMPLEMENTS` rests on an implementation source (`bases`): EUR-Lex lists the publication
as a national implementing measure of the act, or it enacted or changed the regulation
(`national_implementing_measure`, `meta.publications`), or the considerans of the
regulation says it implements the act (`considerans`). It links instruments: no source
names the article that implements. `REFERS_TO`: the text of the regulation names the
CELEX number of an act it does not implement.

id.title: Id
id.description: Node id (``collection/key``) of the article or instrument.

ExplainedTargetDTO.title: ExplainedTargetDTO
ExplainedTargetDTO.description:
What an explanatory document explains: an article, or a law as a whole.

A version of an article resolves to the article itself; a law the document
explains without naming articles is an instrument with ``article_number`` null.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: 'TK' or 'EK'; null for a document that belongs to neither chamber, such as a Staatsblad or Staatscourant publication.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source, e.g. 'tk', 'eerstekamer', 'staatsblad'.

is_explanatory.title: Is Explanatory
is_explanatory.description: An explanatory memorandum (memorie of nota van toelichting): a document of this kind explains the articles it introduces or changes.

dossier_number.title: Dossier Number
dossier_number.description: The dossier the document is PART_OF (the lowest, if several).

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: Its number in its own dossier (nr. 3); null for none.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

kind_group.title: Kind Group
kind_group.description: What the paper or case is, by its Soort (`kind`): `motie` or `amendement` (also a changed one), `wetsvoorstel`, `brief` (a Soort beginning with Brief), `overig`; null without a Soort.

ExplainingDocumentDTO.title: ExplainingDocumentDTO
ExplainingDocumentDTO.description: The explanatory document of an explanation.

value.title: Value
value.description: Null counts the items without one.

FacetCountDTO.title: FacetCountDTO
FacetCountDTO.description: One value of a facet and how many items have it under the current filters.

FactionBoardSeatDTO.title: FactionBoardSeatDTO
FactionBoardSeatDTO.description: A seat on the board of a faction of the Eerste Kamer, as its page gives it.

observed_from.title: Observed From
observed_from.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day a snapshot of eerstekamer.nl first showed it (not the day it began: the site gives no start as data); null for the Tweede Kamer.

observed_until.title: Observed Until
observed_until.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day of the first snapshot that no longer showed it (not the day it ended); null while it is shown.

board.title: Board
board.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: its board.

source.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the page it was read from.

active_until.title: Active Until
active_until.description: The last day, inclusive (the Kamer's TotEnMet); null while open.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

FactionDetailDTO.title: FactionDetailDTO
FactionDetailDTO.description: Response for GET /api/factions/{key} — the node as stored.

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: The last day, inclusive (the Kamer's TotEnMet); null while open.

FactionMembershipDTO.title: FactionMembershipDTO
FactionMembershipDTO.description: One stretch of a member's membership of a faction.

id.title: Id
id.description: Null for a faction of the Eerste Kamer of the past (``date``), which only its name is known by.

seats.title: Seats
seats.description: Its seats: with ``date`` those its members held that day, else the number the Kamer gives.

vacant.title: Vacant
vacant.description: With ``date`` (Tweede Kamer): its seats no member held that day (FractieZetelVacature); with ``seats`` its seats as a cabinet's stretches count them (``/api/cabinets/{key}/seats``). 0 otherwise.

color.title: Color
color.description: The colour this Kamer draws the faction in (the first of `colors`), else the party's house colour; null for none.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Every colour this Kamer draws the faction in, as it draws them: two for a faction drawn in stripes (PRO in the Tweede Kamer); empty when it draws none the list knows.

coalition.title: Coalition
coalition.description: Of the coalition of the cabinet in office that day (`cabinet`): its party held a post in it; a faction split off a coalition party is opposition. Null when no cabinet was in office.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

FactionSeatsDTO.title: FactionSeatsDTO
FactionSeatsDTO.description: A party's seats, and where it sits in the hemicycle.

number.title: Number
number.description: Its number: ``3:2``.

law.title: Law
law.description: The citation title of its law.

law_short.title: Law Short
law_short.description: The abbreviation its law is cited by: ``Awb``; null without.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Of an amendment: what it proposes to do with the article.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

FeedArticleDTO.title: FeedArticleDTO
FeedArticleDTO.description: An article an event is tied to.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The kind of the regulation itself, in lower case as ``/delegated`` gives it: ``amvb``, ``ministeriele-regeling``.

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: The article numbers of the law it names, in the order of the law.

FeedBasisDTO.title: FeedBasisDTO
FeedBasisDTO.description: The law a regulation is issued under: what its preamble ("Gelet op") names.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: ``establishes``: the publication enacted the law (the law names it as the publication that enacted it); ``amends``, ``introduces`` or ``repeals``: every change it makes in the law is of that kind (``AMENDS``, ``INTRODUCES``, ``REPEALS`` of its articles or of the law), ``amends`` where they are of more kinds.

article_count.title: Article Count
article_count.description: The articles it changes, adds or repeals; of a law it enacts, the articles of the law.

FeedChangedInstrumentDTO.title: FeedChangedInstrumentDTO
FeedChangedInstrumentDTO.description: A law a publication enacts or changes.

changed_articles.title: Changed Articles
changed_articles.description: The articles with a version that begins that day.

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: Their numbers, in the order of the law; at most fifty.

new.title: New
new.description: The law itself comes into force: the day is the one it came into force as enacted (its ``date_in_force``).

publication.description: The publication most of those versions came from (their ``origin_publication``): of a new law the one that enacted it; null without.

based_on.description: The law the regulation is issued under (``BASED_ON``), the one its preamble names most articles of; null for a law issued under none.

FeedCommencementDTO.title: FeedCommencementDTO
FeedCommencementDTO.description: An ``inwerkingtreding``: a new version of a law in force from ``date``.

expected_resolution.title: Expected Resolution
expected_resolution.description: The day it is due; null when the Kamer names none.

dossiers.title: Dossiers
dossiers.description: Per kind (in the order of a day) and first dossier of an event, most first within a kind.

FeedDayDTO.title: FeedDayDTO
FeedDayDTO.description: The events of one day, counted.

FeedDossierCountDTO.title: FeedDossierCountDTO
FeedDossierCountDTO.description: The events of one kind in one dossier on a day.

number.title: Number
number.description: The label: ``36600-VII``, a path segment.

short_title.title: Short Title
short_title.description: The name it goes by: of a budget its chapter and year, else the parentheses that end its title, else the citation title its bill gives itself, the Kamer gives the bill's case, or of the one law the bill changes; null without.

short_title_basis.title: Short Title Basis
short_title_basis.description: Where ``short_title`` comes from: ``title``, ``citation``, ``case`` or ``amended_law`` (then it names the law changed, not the bill).

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: ``TK``, ``EK``; null for a publication or a commencement.

coalition.title: Coalition
coalition.description: What the coalition did on the votes of the Tweede Kamer: ``together``, ``split`` (with ``wissel``), ``wissel``, ``decisive``; a vote counts for each that holds, an event without a coalition vote for none.

FeedFacetsDTO.title: FeedFacetsDTO

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

surname.title: Surname
surname.description: Of the first submitter (``indiener``): ``van der Plas`` of ``motie-Van der Plas``; null without one.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: What the title says it is about: the part after the first `` over ``; null when it has none.

short_title.title: Short Title
short_title.description: The short title of the event's dossier (``dossier.short_title``).

FeedHeadlineDTO.title: FeedHeadlineDTO
FeedHeadlineDTO.description: The parts a headline is made of; the front end makes the sentence.

FeedInstrumentDTO.title: FeedInstrumentDTO
FeedInstrumentDTO.description: A law the event is about.

date.title: Date
date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the source gives no time of day.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The whole text of a commitment, the decision of a vote (``Aangenomen.``), the inhoudsindicatie of a judgment; null for the other kinds.

has_text.title: Has Text
has_text.description: Of a paper: whether its text is in the data, so that it can be opened (a new paper's text follows its PDF by days); null for the other kinds.

dictum.title: Dictum
dictum.description: Of a motion: what it asks or says (``verzoekt de regering …``), as ``GET /api/documents/{key}`` gives it; null for the other kinds and a motion without text.

subkind.title: Subkind
subkind.description: What the source calls it: the document kind (``Motie (gewijzigd/nader)``), for a vote what was voted on (the ``Zaak.Soort``: ``Motie``, ``Amendement``, ``Wetgeving``, ...); null for the other kinds.

dossier.description: Its first dossier; null for an event without one.

persons.title: Persons
persons.description: Who signed it, in the order of the source: the submitters of a paper, of the paper a vote decided, the bewindspersoon of a commitment.

ministry.description: Of a commitment its own; otherwise the ministry that brought its dossier in (``ministry`` of the dossier).

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The official text of a publication or a version of a law.

tk_url.title: Tk Url
tk_url.description: The page of a paper on tweedekamer.nl.

number.title: Number
number.description: Of a paper its nr. in its dossier (``12``); null for the other kinds.

matched.title: Matched
matched.description: With ``q``: per word the event holds, where it holds it; empty without ``q``.

via.description: With ``instrument``: how the event is tied to the law; null without.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Of a letter of the government: the motions and commitments it answers (``ANSWERS``); empty for the other kinds.

answered_by.title: Answered By
answered_by.description: Of a commitment: the letters that fulfil it (``ANSWERS``); empty for the other kinds.

amends_articles.title: Amends Articles
amends_articles.description: Of an amendment: the articles it proposes to change, add or repeal (``AMENDS``, ``INTRODUCES``, ``REPEALS``, ``voorgesteld``), in the order of their law; at most twenty.

replaces.description: Of a changed motion or amendment: the paper it replaces ("ter vervanging van nr. 19", ``REVISES``); null for the others.

cites.title: Cites
cites.description: Of a judgment: the articles it cites (``REFERS_TO``), the most mentioned first; at most five.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

kind_group.title: Kind Group
kind_group.description: Of a paper, and of a vote what was voted on (``subkind``): What the paper or case is, by its Soort (`kind`): `motie` or `amendement` (also a changed one), `wetsvoorstel`, `brief` (a Soort beginning with Brief), `overig`; null without a Soort. Null for the other kinds.

cite.description: The judgment as a lawyer cites it: `short` `HR 20 december 2019`, `Rb. Den Haag 6 december 2019`, `Conclusie A-G Hartlief 20 december 2019` (`P-G` where a procureur-generaal signed it), `HvJ EU 22 juni 2023, C-160/20` (a court of the Union with its case number); `full` with its ECLI. Null without an ECLI.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: How it ended, from the first clause of its decision (Beslissing, Dictum): `verworpen` (verwerpt het beroep), `vernietigd`, `gedeeltelijk vernietigd`, `vernietigd en verwezen`, `bekrachtigd`, `bevestigd`, `gegrond`, `ongegrond`, `niet-ontvankelijk`, `afgewezen`, `toegewezen`; of the ECHR `schending` (a violation found) or `geen schending`. Null for a conclusion, and when the decision does not say one of them first (a conviction, an interim decision).

outcome_text.title: Outcome Text
outcome_text.description: The clause that says it, as the decision writes it: "verwerpt het beroep", "vernietigt de aangevallen uitspraak"; of the ECHR the finding.

conclusion_outcome.title: Conclusion Outcome
conclusion_outcome.description: Of a conclusion of the A-G or P-G, what it proposes (its strekking): `verwerping`, `vernietiging`, `vernietiging en verwijzing`, `niet-ontvankelijkverklaring`, `gegrondverklaring`, `ongegrondverklaring`, `beantwoording` (of preliminary questions); null for a judgment and when the conclusion does not say it.

conclusion_outcome_text.title: Conclusion Outcome Text
conclusion_outcome_text.description: The sentence that says it: "De conclusie strekt tot verwerping van het cassatieberoep."

echr_findings.title: Echr Findings
echr_findings.description: Of the ECHR, what it found per article, in the order of HUDOC; empty for any other judgment.

procedure.title: Procedure
procedure.description: As the source gives it: `Cassatie`, `Hoger beroep`.

decided_on.title: Decided On
decided_on.description: The date of the decision (YYYY-MM-DD), before its publication.

advocate_general.title: Advocate General
advocate_general.description: Of a conclusion, who wrote it (as on the detail).

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

publicatie``), of the highest courts unless a ``tier`` is asked for; how it ended.

number.title: Number

dossier.title: Dossier
dossier.description: Of a paper the label of its own dossier (``36764``).

surname.title: Surname
surname.description: Of a paper its first signatory: ``Kathmann``.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

kind_group.title: Kind Group
kind_group.description: Of a paper: What the paper or case is, by its Soort (`kind`): `motie` or `amendement` (also a changed one), `wetsvoorstel`, `brief` (a Soort beginning with Brief), `overig`; null without a Soort. Null for a commitment.

FeedLinkDTO.title: FeedLinkDTO
FeedLinkDTO.description: A paper or a commitment an event is tied to.

term.title: Term
term.description: The word of ``q``, as it was asked.

field.title: Field
field.description: ``title``: the title of the event (of a bill its own, which may not be the ``title`` the item shows: that of its dossier); ``dossier_title``: the whole title of its first dossier; ``laws``: of a publication, the names of the laws it enacts or changes (the official title of a law it enacts too). The first of these that holds it.

FeedMatchDTO.title: FeedMatchDTO
FeedMatchDTO.description: Where an event holds a word of ``q``.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

FeedNodeDTO.title: FeedNodeDTO
FeedNodeDTO.description: The node an event is: ``/api/nodes/{collection}/{key}`` shows it.

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: Per kind of event (as ``kind`` of ``GET /api/feed``), those it has.

amendment_chains.description: The chains of amendment papers (REVISES) of which any paper is an event under the filters, each once in the period of its first paper, by the outcome of its last (the latest decision with an outcome on its case, else the latest); null when ``kind`` leaves the amendments out.

FeedPeriodDTO.title: FeedPeriodDTO
FeedPeriodDTO.description: The events of one month or day.

periods.title: Periods
periods.description: Oldest first; a period without events is left out.

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: The counts took past the budget of the request, or the events were never written: ``periods`` is then empty.

written_at.title: Written At
written_at.description: When the events were last written (``lawgraph feed-events``): the counts lag the feed by at most the time since.

data_as_of.title: Data As Of
data_as_of.description: Per source: how current the graph is, as in `GET /api/stats`.

FeedPeriodsResponse.title: FeedPeriodsResponse
FeedPeriodsResponse.description: The events of the feed per month or day.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name they go by and the surname: ``Hanneke Steen``.

surname.title: Surname
surname.description: With its prefix, as written: ``van der Plas``.

function.title: Function
function.description: What they signed as, as the source writes it: ``minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid``, ``Tweede Kamerlid``.

faction.description: The faction a Kamerlid signed for; null for a bewindspersoon.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

FeedPersonDTO.title: FeedPersonDTO
FeedPersonDTO.description:
Someone who signed the event: submitted a paper (``indiener``), signed it with the
one who did (``medeindiener``), or signed it or made the commitment for the
government (``bewindspersoon``).

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: How it is cited: ``Stb. 2026, 94``; null when its series, year or number is unknown.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.description: The laws it enacts, then those it amends, introduces or repeals (or articles of), by title; at most ten.

FeedPublicationDTO.title: FeedPublicationDTO
FeedPublicationDTO.description: A ``publicatie`` in the Staatsblad, the Staatscourant or the Tractatenblad.

key.title: Key
key.description: Its node key (``stb_2026_187``); null when it is not in the data.

citation.title: Citation
citation.description: How it is cited: ``Stb. 2026, 94``; null when its series, year or number is unknown.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

FeedPublicationRefDTO.title: FeedPublicationRefDTO
FeedPublicationRefDTO.description: The publication a new version of a law came from.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as ``cursor`` for the next page; null on the last page.

total.title: Total
total.description: Events under the filters, all pages; null without facets.

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: Part of the answer is still to come: ``total`` and ``facets`` were asked for but are still being counted (under a filter not counted before, that takes a minute or more): null now, ask again; or, with ``searched_from``, the search for ``q`` or ``faction`` did not reach the first event.

searched_from.title: Searched From
searched_from.description: With ``q`` or ``faction`` and no ``since``: the first day searched when the search stopped before the first event (YYYY-MM-DD). The events found are those from that day on; ask with ``until`` the day before (and no ``cursor``) for older ones. Null when every day was searched.

data_as_of.title: Data As Of
data_as_of.description: Per source: how current the graph is, as in `GET /api/stats`.

days.title: Days
days.description: Every day of the window, newest first.

items.title: Items
items.description: The events shown one by one, feed order.

data_as_of.title: Data As Of
data_as_of.description: Per source: how current the graph is, as in `GET /api/stats`.

FeedSummaryResponse.title: FeedSummaryResponse
FeedSummaryResponse.description: A few days of the feed in one answer.

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: Of a publication: it ``establishes`` the law, or ``amends``, ``introduces`` or ``repeals`` articles of it; of a paper: it ``proposes`` to change it; of a new version: of the law itself (``version_of``) or of a regulation ``based_on`` it; of a judgment: it ``refers_to`` it; of an event of a dossier (``dossier``): the law or a publication of it was ``legislated_in`` that dossier, or a paper of it ``proposes`` to change the law.

article.title: Article
article.description: The number of the article of the law it touches, the first in the order of the law; null where it is tied to the law as a whole or by a dossier.

dossier.title: Dossier
dossier.description: The label of the dossier it is tied by; null for the others.

FeedViaDTO.title: FeedViaDTO
FeedViaDTO.description: How an event is tied to the law ``instrument`` (and ``article``) follows.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: The chamber that voted; of the Eerste Kamer only the vote that decided the bill is an event.

tally.title: Tally
tally.description: Seats per choice as the source writes it (``Voor``, ``Tegen``, ``Niet deelgenomen``); members per choice on a roll-call.

method.title: Method
method.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: how it was decided, as its report names it (``Hamerstuk``, ``Stemming bij zitten en opstaan, aangenomen``, ``Hoofdelijke stemming, verworpen``).

decision_kind.title: Decision Kind
decision_kind.description: Of the Tweede Kamer: its ``BesluitSoort`` as the Kamer writes it (``Stemmen - aangenomen``, ``Stemmen - zonder stemming aannemen``: a hamerstuk, no votes).

coalition.description: Of the Tweede Kamer: what the coalition of the cabinet in office did, as ``GET /api/decisions/{key}`` gives it; null without a cabinet or a coalition vote, and of the Eerste Kamer.

coalition_factions.title: Coalition Factions
coalition_factions.description: Of the Tweede Kamer: each coalition faction that cast a seat, with its choice, most seats first; empty where ``coalition`` is null.

function.title: Function
function.description: The post as Rijksoverheid names it: Minister voor Klimaat en Energie.

ministry.description: The ministry the post falls under (``GET /api/ministries``); a minister without portfolio under the ministry the post is placed under.

seat.title: Seat
seat.description: The seat the post is held in: ministry, post and the portfolio the source names (``ienw/minister``, ``jenv/staatssecretaris/rechtsbescherming``); ``#2`` for a second seat the source does not name.

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: The day it ended, as Rijksoverheid gives it: the day of the change, on which the next cabinet (holder, phase) takes office; so the period runs from ``from_date`` up to, not including, ``to_date``, and ``to_date`` is the ``from_date`` of what follows. Null while it lasts.

GovernmentFunctionDTO.title: GovernmentFunctionDTO
GovernmentFunctionDTO.description: A post held in a cabinet, as Rijksoverheid names it, and normalised.

GroupExpandedDTO.title: GroupExpandedDTO
GroupExpandedDTO.description: How many children of a group a path search started from.

seats.title: Seats
seats.description: Every seat a member holds: the left block, the chair, the right block, each row by row and place by place. A place no one holds is not listed: a row has as many places as its highest column.

HallDTO.title: HallDTO
HallDTO.description: The plenary hall of the Eerste Kamer as Wie zit waar on eerstekamer.nl draws it.

block.title: Block
block.description: ``left`` or ``right`` seen from the government, looking at the chair; ``chair`` the seat of the Voorzitter.

row.title: Row
row.description: From the government (0) to the chair.

column.title: Column
column.description: From the outer wall (0) to the aisle; 0 for the chair.

HallPlaceDTO.title: HallPlaceDTO
HallPlaceDTO.description: A seat of the hall and who holds it.

block.title: Block
block.description: ``left`` or ``right`` seen from the government, looking at the chair; ``chair`` the seat of the Voorzitter.

row.title: Row
row.description: From the government (0) to the chair.

column.title: Column
column.description: From the outer wall (0) to the aisle; 0 for the chair.

HallSeatDTO.title: HallSeatDTO
HallSeatDTO.description:
A place in the plenary hall of the Eerste Kamer: two blocks of benches facing each
other, rows from the government to the chair, and the seat of the Voorzitter.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version of the API (a deploy checks its tag).

warm.title: Warm
warm.description: The answers every visitor asks are computed for the data as it is now; null when the API does not warm up.

warm_version.title: Warm Version
warm_version.description: The data version the last warm-up was done for (null before it).

data_version.title: Data Version
data_version.description: The data version now (null without warm-up).

computing.title: Computing
computing.description: A warm-up waits or runs, or an answer of the cache is computed.

pools.title: Pools
pools.description: Per connection pool (`requests`, `background`; null before the background one is first needed) its use.

busy.title: Busy
busy.description: The calls the threads of the shared pools run now, longest first.

HealthDTO.title: HealthDTO
HealthDTO.description: Whether the API reaches its database, and how warm and busy it is.

leden.title: Leden
leden.description: Numbers of the leden named (`['1', '2']`), ranges written out.

onderdelen.title: Onderdelen
onderdelen.description: Letters or numbers of the onderdelen named (`['a']`, `['2']`).

text.title: Text
text.description: The reference in the preamble: `16, eerste en zevende lid`; a range names each of its articles: `26 tot en met 30`.

basis_kind.title: Basis Kind
basis_kind.description: `delegates`: the leden named (none: the whole article) give the power the regulation is made under (a delegation formula, "bij besluit van", "kan regels stellen"); `mentioned`: the article is only named in the preamble (Awb 3:4 by a policy rule); null: not known (an article without text).

referring.title: Referring
referring.description: The articles in force of the regulation that refer to it, in the order of the regulation, each with the parts of it they name.

ImplementedBasisArticleDTO.title: ImplementedBasisArticleDTO
ImplementedBasisArticleDTO.description:
An article a regulation is issued under, with the articles of the regulation that
refer to it: those that work it out.

title.title: Title
title.description: Its title, as EUR-Lex gives it.

type.title: Type
type.description: The kind of act, as EUR-Lex gives it: `Wet`.

id.title: Id
id.description: The node id of the publication (``instruments/stb_2013_102``), loaded or not.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/stb/2013/102``); null for an id that makes none.

ImplementingMeasureDTO.title: ImplementingMeasureDTO
ImplementingMeasureDTO.description:
A national implementing measure as EUR-Lex lists it for the EU act: the publication
through which the instrument implements it (the law that changed the Awb to implement a
directive).

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: Its anchor in the whole law, the path of labels down to it (its title where it has none): `deel-hoofdstuk-10-titel-10.2-afdeling-10.2.2`, as `division` takes it.

InstrumentArticleBreadcrumbDTO.title: InstrumentArticleBreadcrumbDTO
InstrumentArticleBreadcrumbDTO.description:
One division an article stands in, outermost first: ``type`` is the element of the
BWB XML (``boek``, ``titeldeel``, ``hoofdstuk``, ``afdeling``, ``paragraaf``, ...),
``label`` as printed ("Hoofdstuk 1"), ``title`` its heading.

official_id.title: Official Id
official_id.description: Of an article of a law the BWB does not hold (yet): the id of the Staatsblad publication that enacted its law (`stb-2026-56`), which names the law in the article routes (`/api/articles/STB-2026-56/2.8.6`) and in its address.

article_number.title: Article Number
article_number.description: Null for an article with only a heading, and for a repealed one.

label.title: Label
label.description: `Artikel 287`, or the heading of an article without a number (`Algemene bepaling`).

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: The title of its kop (`Definities`); most articles have none.

address.title: Address
address.description: The `{article_number}` segment of the article routes: the number (`287`, `8:54`), or for an article without one the rest of its key (`stam_16464063` of the Algemene bepaling of the Grondwet; a repealed identity `2_10_stam_2866303`). It stays the same across versions.

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The article in force on wetten.overheid.nl (its JCI).

repealed.title: Repealed
repealed.description: The article is no longer in force: an identity whose number another article has now, or one its current version repeals.

last_article_number.title: Last Article Number
last_article_number.description: The number a repealed identity last had.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

InstrumentArticleNodeDTO.title: InstrumentArticleNodeDTO
InstrumentArticleNodeDTO.description:
Lightweight article shape for the graph-loader.

No full ``text`` field — that would balloon the payload when loading
hundreds of articles for a single instrument. ``text_preview`` carries
the first few characters so the FE has something to render on the node;
use /api/articles/{bwb_id}/{article_number} for full content.

label.title: Label
label.description: `Artikel 1:3`, or the heading of an article without a number.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: The title of its kop (`Definities`); most articles have none.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: The divisions the article stood in on the day asked for, outermost first: those of the toestand of that day.

valid_until.title: Valid Until
valid_until.description: The first day the version is no longer in force, exclusive: the start of the next one. `2021-07-01` is in force up to and including 2021-06-30 (wetten.overheid.nl: "t/m 30-06-2021"). Null while it is in force.

text.title: Text
text.description: The whole text; null when it was not asked for.

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: The aanhef, leden and onderdelen of the text as spans of it, as the article gives them (`lid-2-onder-a`, `onder-_39-onder-a`: an onderdeel inside an unmarked one); empty when the text was not asked for.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: The tables in the text as spans of it; empty when the text was not asked for.

headings.title: Headings
headings.description: The headings in the text as spans of it; empty when the text was not asked for.

text_preview.title: Text Preview
text_preview.description: The first ``text_preview_chars`` characters of the text.

references.title: References
references.description: With ``include=references``: the references of the article, as ``/api/articles/{bwb_id}/{article_number}`` gives them; null when not asked for, and for a version that is not the current one of its article (they are spans of the current text).

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: With ``include=references``: the citations of the article, as the article gives them without ``definition_ref``; null as ``references``.

InstrumentArticleVersionDTO.title: InstrumentArticleVersionDTO
InstrumentArticleVersionDTO.description: One historical version of a single BWB article, in its place on the day asked for.

total.title: Total
total.description: Every article in force on ``at_date`` (of the division, with ``division``), independent of ``limit`` and ``offset``.

first_version_from.title: First Version From
first_version_from.description: The start of the first toestand of the law the source gives (the oldest ``valid_from`` of its versions). Before it the source gives no law: the route is empty, also where an article's own ``valid_from`` is older.

division.description: With ``division``: the division the list is cut to, its heading and its place in the whole list; else null.

InstrumentArticlesAtResponse.title: InstrumentArticlesAtResponse
InstrumentArticlesAtResponse.description: Articles of an instrument as-of a specific date.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute count of articles matching the request, independent of ``limit`` — use to render a '+N more' badge.

division.description: With ``division``: the division the list is cut to, its heading and its place in the whole list; else null.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Its BWB type, lower case.

basis_kind.title: Basis Kind
basis_kind.description: `delegates` when one of `articles` does; `delegates`: the leden named (none: the whole article) give the power the regulation is made under (a delegation formula, "bij besluit van", "kan regels stellen"); `mentioned`: the article is only named in the preamble (Awb 3:4 by a policy rule); null: not known (an article without text).

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: The articles in force of the law its preamble names, in the order of the law, each with the articles of the regulation that refer to it (`referring`).

InstrumentBasisItem.title: InstrumentBasisItem
InstrumentBasisItem.description: A law a regulation is issued under, with the articles its preamble names.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

items.title: Items
items.description: Every law its preamble names an article in force of, by title.

InstrumentDefinitionsResponse.title: InstrumentDefinitionsResponse
InstrumentDefinitionsResponse.description: The definitions an instrument gives itself.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Its BWB type, lower case: `amvb`, `ministeriele-regeling`, `kb`, …

date_in_force.title: Date In Force
date_in_force.description: When the regulation itself entered into force.

basis_kind.title: Basis Kind
basis_kind.description: `delegates` when one of `articles` does: the law gives the power it is made under; `mentioned` when it only names them ("Genoemd in de aanhef van"); null when not known.

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: The articles of the law it is issued under, in the order of the law, each with its articles that work it out (`referring`).

also_based_on.title: Also Based On
also_based_on.description: The other laws its preamble names (its co-bases), by title, each with the articles in force it names.

sub_delegated.title: Sub Delegated
sub_delegated.description: The regulations in force issued under its articles in turn, one level down (not one issued under this law itself: an item of its own); AMvBs first, then by title.

InstrumentDelegatedItem.title: InstrumentDelegatedItem
InstrumentDelegatedItem.description: A regulation whose preamble ("Gelet op") names an article of the law.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

items.title: Items
items.description: Every regulation in force issued under an article of the law: AMvBs first, then ministerial regulations, then the others; by title.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: BWB id of a Dutch regulation or treaty; `BWBV0001000` for the Convention of the ECHR.

celex.title: Celex
celex.description: CELEX number of an EU act.

abbreviation.title: Abbreviation
abbreviation.description: The abbreviation it is cited by: its WTI short title (EVRM), else the one kept by hand for it (AVG); the same as `instrument_abbreviation` on its articles.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Every name it is cited by: the official abbreviations and, for a book of a code, `Boek 6 BW`, `6 BW`, `BW 6`, `BW6`, `BW`.

legal_areas.title: Legal Areas
legal_areas.description: The legal areas of a BWB regulation as its WTI files it (`main`, `specific`), each with the URI of its concept in the TOOI thesaurus `scw_bwb_rechtsgebieden` (null when the thesaurus lacks the label).

policy_domains.title: Policy Domains
policy_domains.description: The government themes of a BWB regulation as its WTI files it (`label`), with the URI of its concept in the TOOI thesaurus `scw_bwb_themas`.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: BWB type (`wet`, `AMvB`, `verdrag`, ...), treaty kind or publication kind.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source that created the node (`bwb`, `eurlex`, ...).

amending.title: Amending
amending.description: A BWB regulation that changes other regulations rather than standing on its own, as on the list.

expired_on.title: Expired On
expired_on.description: The first day it was no longer in force (repealed or lapsed), as the BWB gives it; null while in force.

date_signed.title: Date Signed
date_signed.description: When the instrument itself was signed; for a BWB regulation that of the publication that enacted it, not of a later amendment.

date_published.title: Date Published
date_published.description: When the instrument itself was published.

date_in_force.title: Date In Force
date_in_force.description: When the instrument itself entered into force.

version_date_in_force.title: Version Date In Force
version_date_in_force.description: BWB: the start of the version in force (its toestand).

treaty_number.title: Treaty Number
treaty_number.description: A treaty: its Verdragenbank id (six digits), which the BWB text of the treaty names too (`wetgeving@verdragnummer`).

status.title: Status
status.description: Of a law of the Staatsblad the BWB does not hold (yet) `vastgesteld`: its text as the Staatsblad published it (`official_id`), not in force (`in_force` false); of a treaty of the Verdragenbank its status there.

official_id.title: Official Id
official_id.description: Of a publication its id at officielebekendmakingen.nl (`stb-2019-33`); of a law of the Staatsblad that of the publication that enacted it (`stb-2026-56`).

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The official text: wetten.overheid.nl for a BWB regulation, EUR-Lex for an EU act, the Verdragenbank for a treaty, zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl for a publication from 1995; null for none.

same_treaty.title: Same Treaty
same_treaty.description: The other instruments with its treaty number: the Verdragenbank record of a BWB treaty, the BWB text of a Verdragenbank treaty.

treaty.description: Of a treaty of the Verdragenbank: where it was signed, its Tractatenblad publications, its parties with their dates, the parts of the Kingdom, the dossiers of its approval and the treaties it belongs to or that belong to it. Null for any other instrument.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

InstrumentDetailDTO.title: InstrumentDetailDTO
InstrumentDetailDTO.description: One instrument: its identifiers, names, classification and dates.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: Its anchor, the path of labels down to it: `deel-hoofdstuk-10-titel-10.2-afdeling-10.2.2`.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: The divisions from the outermost down to this one, itself last.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: The place of its first article in the whole list (the same request without ``division``): an ``offset`` to read on from there.

InstrumentDivisionDTO.title: InstrumentDivisionDTO
InstrumentDivisionDTO.description: The division a list of articles is cut to (``division``).

short_title.title: Short Title
short_title.description: The name the dossier goes by (``Cyberbeveiligingswet``), as ``/api/dossiers`` gives it; null without one.

current_phase.title: Current Phase
current_phase.description: The current phase of the dossier's bill (``phases``).

via.title: Via
via.description: How the dossier is linked: ``instrument`` = LEGISLATED_IN from the regulation itself, ``amending_publication`` = LEGISLATED_IN from a publication that amends, introduces or repeals one of its articles.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: Identifier (e.g. ``stb-2019-33``) of the newest amending publication linking the dossier; only set when ``via`` is ``amending_publication``.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

InstrumentDossierItem.title: InstrumentDossierItem
InstrumentDossierItem.description: One parliamentary dossier touching this instrument.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute number of dossiers touching this instrument (independent of ``limit``).

implemented_by.title: Implemented By
implemented_by.description: National publications and regulations that implement this act.

mentions.title: Mentions
mentions.description: EU acts whose CELEX number the text of this regulation names and that it does not implement (`REFERS_TO`).

mentioned_by.title: Mentioned By
mentioned_by.description: Regulations that name this act and do not implement it.

international.title: International
international.description: Treaties that articles of this instrument refer to and ECHR judgments that refer to it, at most `limit`, treaties first.

legal_area.title: Legal Area
legal_area.description: The legal areas of the TOOI thesaurus `scw_bwb_rechtsgebieden` as a tree: main areas, most first, each with its specific areas (`narrower`). An instrument counts once per area. Counted without the `legal_area` filter.

policy_domain.title: Policy Domain
policy_domain.description: The government themes of `scw_bwb_themas`, most first. Counted without the `policy_domain` filter.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Per kind (`wet`, `verdrag`, `multilateraalverdrag`, …), most first. Counted without the `kind` filter, over the list without a kind (no publications).

amending.title: Amending
amending.description: The regulations that change others (`true`) and those of their own (`false`), most first. Counted without the `amending` filter.

validity.title: Validity
validity.description: The instruments in force today (`in_force`) and those no longer in force (`expired`), most first. Counted without the `validity` filter.

InstrumentFacets.title: InstrumentFacets
InstrumentFacets.description:
The instruments under the filters, counted per register; each without its own
filter, so the other areas stay in view when one is chosen.

year.title: Year
year.description: Per year of the judgment, the oldest first; `value` null counts those without a date.

InstrumentJudgmentFacets.title: InstrumentJudgmentFacets
InstrumentJudgmentFacets.description: Every judgment that cites this instrument counted, not the page.

cite.description: The judgment as a lawyer cites it: `short` `HR 20 december 2019`, `Rb. Den Haag 6 december 2019`, `Conclusie A-G Hartlief 20 december 2019` (`P-G` where a procureur-generaal signed it), `HvJ EU 22 juni 2023, C-160/20` (a court of the Union with its case number); `full` with its ECLI. Null without an ECLI.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: How it ended, from the first clause of its decision (Beslissing, Dictum): `verworpen` (verwerpt het beroep), `vernietigd`, `gedeeltelijk vernietigd`, `vernietigd en verwezen`, `bekrachtigd`, `bevestigd`, `gegrond`, `ongegrond`, `niet-ontvankelijk`, `afgewezen`, `toegewezen`; of the ECHR `schending` (a violation found) or `geen schending`. Null for a conclusion, and when the decision does not say one of them first (a conviction, an interim decision).

outcome_text.title: Outcome Text
outcome_text.description: The clause that says it, as the decision writes it: "verwerpt het beroep", "vernietigt de aangevallen uitspraak"; of the ECHR the finding.

conclusion_outcome.title: Conclusion Outcome
conclusion_outcome.description: Of a conclusion of the A-G or P-G, what it proposes (its strekking): `verwerping`, `vernietiging`, `vernietiging en verwijzing`, `niet-ontvankelijkverklaring`, `gegrondverklaring`, `ongegrondverklaring`, `beantwoording` (of preliminary questions); null for a judgment and when the conclusion does not say it.

conclusion_outcome_text.title: Conclusion Outcome Text
conclusion_outcome_text.description: The sentence that says it: "De conclusie strekt tot verwerping van het cassatieberoep."

echr_findings.title: Echr Findings
echr_findings.description: Of the ECHR, what it found per article, in the order of HUDOC; empty for any other judgment.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: The tier, the Type of the court in the Instanties value list: `hoge_raad`, `raad_van_state`, `gerechtshof`, `rechtbank`, … (as in `/api/judgments`).

court_kind.title: Court Kind
court_kind.description: The kind of court within the tier.

advocate_general.title: Advocate General
advocate_general.description: For a conclusion, the advocate-general who wrote it, as on `/api/judgments/{ecli}`. Null for a judgment.

advocate_general_role.title: Advocate General Role
advocate_general_role.description: For a conclusion, the role it is signed in (`advocaat-generaal`, `waarnemend advocaat-generaal`, ...), as on `/api/judgments/{ecli}`. Null for a judgment.

cited_articles.title: Cited Articles
cited_articles.description: Articles of the focal instrument that this judgment cites.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

InstrumentJudgmentItem.title: InstrumentJudgmentItem
InstrumentJudgmentItem.description: One judgment that cites this instrument, with how it ended.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute number of judgments citing this instrument (independent of ``limit``).

year.title: Year
year.description: The year asked for (`year`), null for every year.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: The order of `items`: `date`, the newest first; `cited`, the most cited articles of this law first, then the newest. Ties by id.

inbound_citation_count.title: Inbound Citation Count
inbound_citation_count.description: How often the law and its articles are cited (REFERS_TO), as on the instrument's detail.

next_version_from.title: Next Version From
next_version_from.description: The date of the first coming change: the start of the first toestand of the law after today, as the BWB lists it. Null when none is known (and for an EU instrument).

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The official text: wetten.overheid.nl for a BWB regulation, EUR-Lex for an EU act, the Verdragenbank for a treaty, zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl for a publication from 1995; null for none.

amending.title: Amending
amending.description: A BWB regulation that changes other regulations rather than standing on its own (`Aanpassing Delegatiebesluit 1993`): its articles are numbered as a wijzigingsregeling (`Artikel I`) and one or more of them changed another regulation, or most of them did.

expired_on.title: Expired On
expired_on.description: The first day it was no longer in force (repealed or lapsed), as the BWB gives it; null while in force.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

InstrumentReferenceArticleDTO.title: InstrumentReferenceArticleDTO
InstrumentReferenceArticleDTO.description: An article at one end of a reference between two instruments.

leden.title: Leden
leden.description: Numbers of the leden named (`['1', '2']`), ranges written out.

onderdelen.title: Onderdelen
onderdelen.description: Letters or numbers of the onderdelen named (`['a']`, `['2']`).

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: `outbound`: an article of the instrument asked for refers to one of the other; `inbound`: the other way.

source.description: The article that refers.

text.title: Text
text.description: The words of the reference: `artikel 16, eerste lid, van de wet`.

InstrumentReferenceDTO.title: InstrumentReferenceDTO
InstrumentReferenceDTO.description:
A reference from an article of one instrument to an article of the other, with the
parts of the article referred to it names.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: `inbound`: it is issued under articles of this law (its preamble names them); `outbound`: this law is issued under articles of it; `via`: it is issued under articles of the regulation `via`, which is issued under this law.

via.description: With `via`: the regulation it is issued under.

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: The articles in force its preamble names (of this law, of it, or of `via`), in the order of their law.

InstrumentRelatedBasisDTO.title: InstrumentRelatedBasisDTO
InstrumentRelatedBasisDTO.description: How a related instrument and the law are one of a delegation.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Its kind: BWB type lower case (`amvb`, `wet`), or EU type.

date_in_force.title: Date In Force
date_in_force.description: When it entered into force itself.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Which refers to which: `inbound` its articles refer to this law, `outbound` articles of this law refer to it, `both`.

outbound_count.title: Outbound Count
outbound_count.description: Articles in force of this law that refer to articles of it.

outbound_cited_count.title: Outbound Cited Count
outbound_cited_count.description: Its articles in force that those refer to.

inbound_count.title: Inbound Count
inbound_count.description: Its articles in force that refer to articles of this law.

inbound_cited_count.title: Inbound Cited Count
inbound_cited_count.description: Articles in force of this law that those refer to.

based_on.title: Based On
based_on.description: Whether the two are one of a delegation as well: see `basis`.

basis.description: How it and this law are one of a delegation (`BASED_ON`, the preamble of a regulation); null when they are not.

InstrumentRelatedItem.title: InstrumentRelatedItem
InstrumentRelatedItem.description: One other instrument linked via cross-article REFERS_TO edges.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute number of related instruments (independent of ``limit``).

celex.title: Celex
celex.description: CELEX number of an EU act.

abbreviation.title: Abbreviation
abbreviation.description: The abbreviation it is cited by: its WTI short title (EVRM), else the one kept by hand for it (AVG); the same as `instrument_abbreviation` on its articles.

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The official text: wetten.overheid.nl for a BWB regulation, EUR-Lex for an EU act, the Verdragenbank for a treaty, zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl for a publication from 1995; null for none.

inbound_citation_count.title: Inbound Citation Count
inbound_citation_count.description: What refers to the instrument and to its articles.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

valid_until.title: Valid Until
valid_until.description: The first day the version is no longer in force, exclusive: the start of the next one. `2021-07-01` is in force up to and including 2021-06-30 (wetten.overheid.nl: "t/m 30-06-2021"). Null while it is in force.

InstrumentVersionDTO.title: InstrumentVersionDTO
InstrumentVersionDTO.description: One historical version (toestand) of a BWB instrument.

InstrumentVersionsResponse.title: InstrumentVersionsResponse
InstrumentVersionsResponse.description: Paginated list of historical versions for one instrument.

own_article.description: The article of this instrument at the edge, when it has one.

counterpart_article.description: The article of the treaty the reference names.

source.title: Source
source.description: The pipeline that wrote the edge.

InternationalLinkDTO.title: InternationalLinkDTO
InternationalLinkDTO.description:
A `REFERS_TO` edge between this instrument and an international counterpart.

`treaty`: an article of this instrument (`own_article`) refers to a treaty
(`instrument`), and to a treaty article (`counterpart_article`) when the reference names
one. `echr_judgment`: an ECHR judgment (`judgment`) refers to an article of this
instrument (`own_article`) or, without an article, to the instrument as a whole.

short.title: Short
short.description: The court, the author of a conclusion and the day: `HR 20 december 2019`.

JudgmentCiteDTO.title: JudgmentCiteDTO
JudgmentCiteDTO.description: A judgment as a lawyer cites it (``core.judgment_cite``).

paragraph_ids.title: Paragraph Ids
paragraph_ids.description: The paragraphs that cite it, in reading order (a citation in a footnote counts for the paragraph that refers to the footnote).

paragraph_numbers.title: Paragraph Numbers
paragraph_numbers.description: Their printed numbers (`5.3`), those that have one.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The text around the strongest mention.

snippet_paragraph_id.title: Snippet Paragraph Id
snippet_paragraph_id.description: The paragraph the snippet is from (for a citation in a footnote, the paragraph that refers to the footnote; the snippet is then of the footnote).

footnote.title: Footnote
footnote.description: The `label` of the footnote (`judgment.footnotes`) the snippet is from; null when it is from the paragraph itself.

text.title: Text
text.description: The citation as written in the strongest mention: `artikel 12 van de CBW`, `ECLI:NL:HR:1988:AD5713`.

start.title: Start
start.description: Offset of `text` in `snippet`: `snippet[start:end]` is `text`, where the linker found it. Null when the judgment was normalized again since it was linked.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The confidence of the strongest mention.

mention_count.title: Mention Count
mention_count.description: How often the judgment cites it. The paragraphs cover the first 100; a judgment that cites more often is counted in full.

leden.title: Leden
leden.description: Numbers of the leden named (`['1', '2']`), ranges written out.

onderdelen.title: Onderdelen
onderdelen.description: Letters or numbers of the onderdelen named (`['a']`, `['2']`).

qualifier.title: Qualifier
qualifier.description: The qualifier as the judgment wrote it, `derde lid`, of the strongest mention. `leden`, `onderdelen` and `aanhef` (this class) are what it names.

JudgmentCitedArticle.title: JudgmentCitedArticle
JudgmentCitedArticle.description: An article a judgment cites, with where and how: the strongest of its mentions.

paragraph_ids.title: Paragraph Ids
paragraph_ids.description: The paragraphs that cite it, in reading order (a citation in a footnote counts for the paragraph that refers to the footnote).

paragraph_numbers.title: Paragraph Numbers
paragraph_numbers.description: Their printed numbers (`5.3`), those that have one.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The text around the strongest mention.

snippet_paragraph_id.title: Snippet Paragraph Id
snippet_paragraph_id.description: The paragraph the snippet is from (for a citation in a footnote, the paragraph that refers to the footnote; the snippet is then of the footnote).

footnote.title: Footnote
footnote.description: The `label` of the footnote (`judgment.footnotes`) the snippet is from; null when it is from the paragraph itself.

text.title: Text
text.description: The citation as written in the strongest mention: `artikel 12 van de CBW`, `ECLI:NL:HR:1988:AD5713`.

start.title: Start
start.description: Offset of `text` in `snippet`: `snippet[start:end]` is `text`, where the linker found it. Null when the judgment was normalized again since it was linked.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The confidence of the strongest mention.

mention_count.title: Mention Count
mention_count.description: How often the judgment cites it. The paragraphs cover the first 100; a judgment that cites more often is counted in full.

cite.description: The judgment as a lawyer cites it: `short` `HR 20 december 2019`, `Rb. Den Haag 6 december 2019`, `Conclusie A-G Hartlief 20 december 2019` (`P-G` where a procureur-generaal signed it), `HvJ EU 22 juni 2023, C-160/20` (a court of the Union with its case number); `full` with its ECLI. Null without an ECLI.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

JudgmentCitedJudgment.title: JudgmentCitedJudgment
JudgmentCitedJudgment.description: A judgment this one cites (by ECLI, LJN or application number), with where.

cite.description: The judgment as a lawyer cites it: `short` `HR 20 december 2019`, `Rb. Den Haag 6 december 2019`, `Conclusie A-G Hartlief 20 december 2019` (`P-G` where a procureur-generaal signed it), `HvJ EU 22 juni 2023, C-160/20` (a court of the Union with its case number); `full` with its ECLI. Null without an ECLI.

id.title: Id
id.description: Its node id; null when the graph lacks it (then `path` too).

author.title: Author
author.description: The advocaat-generaal or procureur-generaal, as written.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: What it proposes (``conclusion_outcome`` of the conclusion): ``verwerping``, ``vernietiging``, …; null when it does not say it.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

JudgmentConclusionDTO.title: JudgmentConclusionDTO
JudgmentConclusionDTO.description: A conclusion a judgment names (``conclusion_eclis``), as its light node names it.

stubs.title: Stubs
stubs.description: Cited judgments whose text is not loaded.

replaced.title: Replaced
replaced.description: Publications of a decision that another loaded publication replaces (`SAME_AS`); not in `total`, the tiers or the courts.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: Per tier: the highest courts first, the parket, the courts of first instance and appeal, the disciplinary tribunals, the other colleges, the Caribbean part, then the courts outside the Netherlands, the EHRM last.

JudgmentCoverageResponse.title: JudgmentCoverageResponse
JudgmentCoverageResponse.description:
Which judgments the graph holds: a count of case law is a count of this selection.

``total`` counts the judgments whose text is loaded, a decision published twice once
(the ``total`` of ``/api/judgments``); ``stubs`` the judgments known only because a
loaded text cites them (they cite nothing themselves).

kind_group.title: Kind Group
kind_group.description: Of a paper or a case: What the paper or case is, by its Soort (`kind`): `motie` or `amendement` (also a changed one), `wetsvoorstel`, `brief` (a Soort beginning with Brief), `overig`; null without a Soort. Absent for any other node.

cite.description: Of a judgment: The judgment as a lawyer cites it: `short` `HR 20 december 2019`, `Rb. Den Haag 6 december 2019`, `Conclusie A-G Hartlief 20 december 2019` (`P-G` where a procureur-generaal signed it), `HvJ EU 22 juni 2023, C-160/20` (a court of the Union with its case number); `full` with its ECLI. Null without an ECLI. Absent for a node of another collection.

title.title: Title
title.description: Its title, as the `<title>` of its page has it and `title` of `/api/nodes/{collection}/{key}` (`Art. 6:162 BW, Onrechtmatige daad`, `HR 20 december 2019 (Urgenda), ECLI:NL:HR:2019:2006`, `36496 Wet AI-toezicht`), from the props it carries (with `props=canvas` too, which keeps what it reads).

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: How it ended, from the first clause of its decision (Beslissing, Dictum): `verworpen` (verwerpt het beroep), `vernietigd`, `gedeeltelijk vernietigd`, `vernietigd en verwezen`, `bekrachtigd`, `bevestigd`, `gegrond`, `ongegrond`, `niet-ontvankelijk`, `afgewezen`, `toegewezen`; of the ECHR `schending` (a violation found) or `geen schending`. Null for a conclusion, and when the decision does not say one of them first (a conviction, an interim decision).

outcome_text.title: Outcome Text
outcome_text.description: The clause that says it, as the decision writes it: "verwerpt het beroep", "vernietigt de aangevallen uitspraak"; of the ECHR the finding.

conclusion_outcome.title: Conclusion Outcome
conclusion_outcome.description: Of a conclusion of the A-G or P-G, what it proposes (its strekking): `verwerping`, `vernietiging`, `vernietiging en verwijzing`, `niet-ontvankelijkverklaring`, `gegrondverklaring`, `ongegrondverklaring`, `beantwoording` (of preliminary questions); null for a judgment and when the conclusion does not say it.

conclusion_outcome_text.title: Conclusion Outcome Text
conclusion_outcome_text.description: The sentence that says it: "De conclusie strekt tot verwerping van het cassatieberoep."

echr_findings.title: Echr Findings
echr_findings.description: Of the ECHR, what it found per article, in the order of HUDOC; empty for any other judgment.

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The judgment on its official site: uitspraken.rechtspraak.nl by its ECLI, HUDOC by its item id for one of the ECHR; null for a stub of another court.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The inhoudsindicatie, in Dutch. For an English translation the inhoudsindicatie of the judgment it translates; null while that is not loaded.

summary_en.title: Summary En
summary_en.description: An English inhoudsindicatie: that of the judgment itself when it is an English translation, else that of its translation. Null when there is none.

translation_of.title: Translation Of
translation_of.description: For an English translation, the ECLI of the Dutch judgment it translates (the authentic text); null otherwise.

names.title: Names
names.description: What lawyers call the judgment: `Haviltex`, `Urgenda`, `Lindenbaum/Cohen`. From a curated list of landmark cases; empty for most.

decision_kind.title: Decision Kind
decision_kind.description: What the decision is: `arrest`, `vonnis`, `beschikking`, `uitspraak`, `beslissing` (the kantonrechter on an appeal against a traffic fine), `conclusie` or `prejudiciële beslissing`. From the metadata and the kop where they tell, else from the court and the area of law; null when nothing does.

series_id.title: Series Id
series_id.description: The series of parallel cases the judgment is one of (the same court, day and, nearly, text): the lowest ECLI in it. Null outside a series.

series_size.title: Series Size
series_size.description: How many judgments the series has.

same_as.title: Same As
same_as.description: For a publication of a decision that another publication replaces (the Rechtspraak published many old arresten again under a new ECLI), the ECLI of the one kept; for a language version of an ECHR decision without an ECLI, the HUDOC item id of the version kept. The lists show the decision by that one. Null otherwise.

replaced_by.title: Replaced By
replaced_by.description: The ECLI of the publication that replaces this one (`dcterms:isReplacedBy`), loaded or not: `same_as` when it is loaded, a publication not in the graph otherwise. Null for most.

withdrawn.title: Withdrawn
withdrawn.description: How the Rechtspraak withdrew it: `doc` (the document is no longer published) or `ecli` (the ECLI was given in error; `replaced_by` the one the source names instead, null when it names none). It is then a stub with the facts of the decision that name no one (court, date, case number, kind, areas of law), without text, summary, parties or citations of its own; the lists, the search and the feed leave it out. Null while it is published.

withdrawn_on.title: Withdrawn On
withdrawn_on.description: The day it was withdrawn (YYYY-MM-DD); null with it.

published_on.title: Published On
published_on.description: The day it was published on uitspraken.rechtspraak.nl ("Datum publicatie", YYYY-MM-DD), as the source gives it; often weeks after the decision. Null for a judgment of another source or without a published document.

advocate_general.title: Advocate General
advocate_general.description: For a conclusion, the advocate-general (or procureur-generaal) who wrote it, as its kop names them: `T. Hartlief`, `P.J. Wattel`, or only the surname (`Wattel`) where the kop gives no more. Null for a judgment, and for a conclusion whose kop names no one.

advocate_general_role.title: Advocate General Role
advocate_general_role.description: For a conclusion, the role it is signed in, read from its signature: `advocaat-generaal`, `waarnemend advocaat-generaal`, `plaatsvervangend procureur-generaal` or `plaatsvervangend advocaat-generaal`. Null for a judgment, and for a conclusion that writes none or one that is not clear.

unresolved_appeal_targets.title: Unresolved Appeal Targets
unresolved_appeal_targets.description: The decisions an appeal says in its text it appeals ("tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Gelderland van 9 juli 2025 in zaak nr. 24/6811") that are not loaded; one that is loaded is its `APPEAL_OF` edge. Empty for most.

unresolved_citations.title: Unresolved Citations
unresolved_citations.description: The articles the judgment cites of laws that are not in the graph ("art. 392 Rv"): mentioned, not in the network. One per law and article, in reading order. Empty when it cites none, or before `semantic rechtspraak` read it.

footnotes.title: Footnotes
footnotes.description: The footnotes of the text, which are no paragraph, in their order. A citation in one is a span in its `citations`, and names it on the edge by `footnote` (its `label`), its `paragraph_id` the paragraph that refers to it.

parties.title: Parties
parties.description: The parties the kop of the judgment names, in its order. Null when the judgment was normalized before parties were read; empty when the kop names none.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

translation_of_id.title: Translation Of Id
translation_of_id.description: The node id of `translation_of`, loaded or not; null with it.

replaced_by_id.title: Replaced By Id
replaced_by_id.description: The node id of `replaced_by`, loaded or not; null with it.

JudgmentDTO.title: JudgmentDTO
JudgmentDTO.description: Rich judgment DTO that hides raw XML but exposes metadata.

cited_articles.title: Cited Articles
cited_articles.description: The same articles, each with the passages of the judgment that cite it: paragraphs, the lid or onderdeel named, a snippet.

cited_judgments.title: Cited Judgments
cited_judgments.description: The judgments its text cites by ECLI, LJN or application number (`REFERS_TO`), newest first, each with the places that cite it as `cited_articles` has them; not the earlier instances or the conclusion its metadata names.

same_as.title: Same As
same_as.description: The other publications of the same decision (`SAME_AS`): for the one kept those it replaces, for a replaced one the one kept. Empty for most.

related_to.title: Related To
related_to.description: The connected cases (`RELATED_TO`, as between dossiers), both ways: those its summary names ("Samenhang met 24/03860 E", "Zie ook: ECLI:…") and those whose summary names it, each found by its exact ECLI or case number, with the sentence that names it (`links`). Empty for most.
