conclusions.title: Conclusions
conclusions.description: The conclusions its metadata names (``conclusion_eclis``), in that order, each with the A-G or P-G and the date its light node gives; one the graph lacks is its ECLI alone.

series.title: Series
series.description: The other judgments of its series (`judgment.series_id`), in the order of their ECLI numbers; empty outside a series.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Per tier, most first; counted without the `tier` and `court_kind` filters.

court_kind.title: Court Kind
court_kind.description: Per kind of court, most first; counted without the `court_kind` filter (within a chosen `tier`).

source.title: Source
source.description: Per source (`rechtspraak`, `echr`), most first; counted without the `source` filter.

year.title: Year
year.description: Per year of `date` (`2024`), oldest first after null (no date); counted without `from` and `to`.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Per area of law, as the source writes it (`Strafrecht`, `Bestuursrecht; Belastingrecht`), most first; a judgment counts for each of its areas; counted without the `subject` filter.

subject_area.title: Subject Area
subject_area.description: Per main area of law: a subject up to its first `;` (`Bestuursrecht` holds `Bestuursrecht; Belastingrecht`), most first; a judgment counts once for each of its main areas. `narrower`: the subjects under it as the source writes them. The whole tree is counted without the `subject_area` and `subject` filters, so the other areas stay in view when one is chosen.

procedure.title: Procedure
procedure.description: Per procedure (Rechtspraak `psi:procedure`, as written: `Hoger beroep`, `Cassatie`; null when it gives none), most first; counted without the `procedure` filter.

JudgmentFacets.title: JudgmentFacets
JudgmentFacets.description: The judgments under the filters, counted; each without its own filter.

label.title: Label
label.description: As printed: `12`; its place among the footnotes (`3`) when it has none.

paragraph_id.title: Paragraph Id
paragraph_id.description: The paragraph whose footnote marker points to it; null when none does.

at.title: At
at.description: Where that marker stands in the text of the paragraph: its `text[:at]` are the words before it. Null when none does, and for a judgment read before markers were kept.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: Every citation in `text` of an article or a judgment, one per occurrence, with its span (`text[start:end]`).

JudgmentFootnote.title: JudgmentFootnote
JudgmentFootnote.description: A footnote of a judgment, with the citations in it.

cite.description: The judgment as a lawyer cites it: `short` `HR 20 december 2019`, `Rb. Den Haag 6 december 2019`, `Conclusie A-G Hartlief 20 december 2019` (`P-G` where a procureur-generaal signed it), `HvJ EU 22 juni 2023, C-160/20` (a court of the Union with its case number); `full` with its ECLI. Null without an ECLI.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: The coarse tier: the Type of the court in the Instanties value list of the Rechtspraak (`hoge_raad`, `gerechtshof`, `rechtbank`, `tuchtcollege`, `andere_instantie`, `koninkrijksinstantie`, …), or `kroon`, `hvj_eu`, `ehrm`.

court_kind.title: Court Kind
court_kind.description: The kind of court within the tier, from its official name (`ambtenarengerecht`, `raad_van_beroep`, `gerecht_in_eerste_aanleg`, …); a tier of one kind of court is its own kind (`hoge_raad`).

names.title: Names
names.description: What lawyers call the judgment: `Haviltex`, `Urgenda`, `Lindenbaum/Cohen`. From a curated list of landmark cases; empty for most.

decision_kind.title: Decision Kind
decision_kind.description: What the decision is: `arrest`, `vonnis`, `beschikking`, `uitspraak`, `beslissing` (the kantonrechter on an appeal against a traffic fine), `conclusie` or `prejudiciële beslissing`. From the metadata and the kop where they tell, else from the court and the area of law; null when nothing does.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: The areas of law the source gives it (Rechtspraak `dcterms:subject`), as written: `Strafrecht`, `Bestuursrecht; Belastingrecht`. Empty when it gives none.

inbound_citation_count.title: Inbound Citation Count
inbound_citation_count.description: The judgments that cite it, or another publication of the same decision, each once.

outbound_citation_count.title: Outbound Citation Count
outbound_citation_count.description: The judgments its text cites (`cited_judgments` of the detail); null before `semantic graph-list-stats` counted them.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

paragraph_id.title: Paragraph Id
paragraph_id.description: Names the paragraph in the judgment, for a deep link: `rov-5.3` for the numbered consideration 5.3, `kop-5` for a numbered heading, `p-3f2a9c1e` (from its text, not its position: it stays when another paragraph comes or goes) for a paragraph without a number. Unique in the judgment.

number.title: Number
number.description: The number as printed, without its closing dot (`5.3`); not part of `text`. Null for a paragraph without one.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `heading`, `subheading` (a nested heading, or the kop: the first paragraph, up to the end of the parties), `body`, `toc` (a line of a table of contents: no consideration, no heading, an id from its text) or `signature` (the closing lines that sign a conclusion: `De Procureur-Generaal bij de`, `Hoge Raad der Nederlanden`, `A-G`).

continues.title: Continues
continues.description: Of a `body` paragraph without a number: the `paragraph_id` of the numbered consideration it goes on with (`rov-1`), up to the next number or heading. Null otherwise.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: Every citation of an article or a judgment in `text`, one per occurrence, with its span (`text[start:end]`); `target.collection` says which.

JudgmentParagraph.title: JudgmentParagraph
JudgmentParagraph.description: A single paragraph from a judgment, with the article citations in it.

name.title: Name
name.description: As the judgment writes it, anonymised where the source is: `[eiser]`, `MAATSCHAP GRONINGEN`. Without its legal form, place or role.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Every role the judgment names for the party, in its order: `Geïntimeerde` and `Appellant` for one that is geïntimeerde in principaal and appellante in incidenteel hoger beroep. `[role]` when it names none.

role_stated.title: Role Stated
role_stated.description: True when the judgment names the role (a role line, a role behind the name, an anonymised name that is a role: `[verdachte]`); false when it is derived from the area of law and the side.

side.title: Side
side.description: The side of the case: `first` before `tegen` or `en`, `second` after it, `other` for an interested party (belanghebbende).

alias.title: Alias
alias.description: What the judgment calls the party: `EBN` for "hierna: EBN", `KLM` for "geïntimeerden worden hierna KLM respectievelijk VNV genoemd".

JudgmentParty.title: JudgmentParty
JudgmentParty.description: A party of a judgment, read from its kop and its account of the procedure.

name.title: Name
name.description: As written, titles and all: `mr. drs. R. van Gelder`, `mr. R. van der Meulen MPM`.

role.title: Role
role.description: The word the judgment gives: `advocaat`; `raadsman` of a suspect, in a criminal case only; `gemachtigde` for whoever represents a party ("vertegenwoordigd door") without being called its advocaat.

place.title: Place
place.description: Where they practise, as written: `Voorschoten` for "advocaat te Voorschoten". Null when the judgment gives none.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: What else the judgment calls them: `ambtenaar in dienst van de provincie`, `rechtsbijstandverlener`. Null when it gives nothing but the role.

JudgmentRepresentative.title: JudgmentRepresentative
JudgmentRepresentative.description:
Who acts for a party, as the kop ("advocaat: mr. X") or the account of the procedure
("bijgestaan door mr. X, advocaat te Y") names them.

cite.description: The judgment as a lawyer cites it: `short` `HR 20 december 2019`, `Rb. Den Haag 6 december 2019`, `Conclusie A-G Hartlief 20 december 2019` (`P-G` where a procureur-generaal signed it), `HvJ EU 22 juni 2023, C-160/20` (a court of the Union with its case number); `full` with its ECLI. Null without an ECLI.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

JudgmentSummaryDTO.title: JudgmentSummaryDTO
JudgmentSummaryDTO.description: Lightweight judgment summary for listing matches.

main_slug.title: Main Slug
main_slug.description: Its slug, unique in the list: `staats-en-bestuursrecht`.

LegalAreaDTO.title: LegalAreaDTO
LegalAreaDTO.description: A legal area of a regulation (WTI ``rechtsgebied``) and its TOOI concepts.

id.title: Id
id.description: Its TOOI concept (`c_e49bce03`); null without the thesaurus.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Unique in its list (`familierecht`); the filter takes it too.

LegalAreaFacetDTO.title: LegalAreaFacetDTO
LegalAreaFacetDTO.description: A main legal area and its specific areas.

amends.title: Amends
amends.description: The laws it amends, adds to or repeals from (never its own new act).

LegalEffectDTO.title: LegalEffectDTO
LegalEffectDTO.description: What the dossier's law changes and implements, in the order its title names them.

name.title: Name
name.description: The citation title, else the title: `Wet op het financieel toezicht`.

short.title: Short
short.description: The short title the source gives (the WTI afkorting: `Wft`); null where it gives none.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: Where it shows: `voorstel` (a bill of the dossier proposes the change), `staatsblad` (an amending publication of the dossier enacted it), `wet` (the act of the dossier implements it).

LegalEffectItemDTO.title: LegalEffectItemDTO
LegalEffectItemDTO.description: An instrument the dossier changes or implements.

dossier_id.title: Dossier Id
dossier_id.description: Node id (``collection/key``) of the dossier; null when the publication names a dossier that is not in the graph.

dossier_short_title.title: Dossier Short Title
dossier_short_title.description: The name the dossier goes by (``Cyberbeveiligingswet``), as ``/api/dossiers`` gives it; null without one.

date.title: Date
date.description: Of the bill, or the publication date of the publication.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Document kind of a bill, publication kind (`Stb`) of a publication.

change.title: Change
change.description: `establishes`: the publication that enacted the regulation set the article; else the change it made or a bill proposes.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: Node id (``collection/key``) of the publication or the bill.

LegislativeHistoryEntry.title: LegislativeHistoryEntry
LegislativeHistoryEntry.description:
One change of an article in one dossier: the dossier, and the amending publication
(enacted) or the bill (proposed) that made or proposes the change.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

LinkedInstrumentDTO.title: LinkedInstrumentDTO
LinkedInstrumentDTO.description: The instrument at the other end of a link.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the node is: `document`, `dossier`, `article`, `annex`, `instrument`, `judgment`, `commitment`, `case`, `activity`, `faction`, `committee`, `cabinet`.

chamber.title: Chamber
chamber.description: `TK` or `EK` for a paper or a vote; null otherwise.

stub.title: Stub
stub.description: Known only because something cites it (a judgment not loaded): the address shows it as cited only.

props.title: Props
props.description: The props a URL is built back from, those the node has: `ecli`; `bwb_id` or `celex` with `article_number`; `bwb_id` and `label` of an annex; `number` of a zaak or an activity; `dossier_number`, `dossier_suffix`, `sequence` (a paper of the Tweede Kamer) or `number` (the letter of one of the Eerste Kamer); `number` and `suffix` of a dossier; `official_id` or `identifier` (the id of officielebekendmakingen.nl); `replaced_by` and `same_as` of a replaced publication.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

LookupResponse.title: LookupResponse
LookupResponse.description: The one node an exact lookup names, with what its URL is built back from.

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: The last day, inclusive (the Kamer's TotEnMet); null while open.

role.title: Role
role.description: As the Kamer writes it: of the Tweede Kamer the ``Functie`` of the seat (``Lid``, ``Voorzitter``, ``OnderVz``, ``PlvLid``), of the Eerste Kamer the role its page gives (``voorzitter``); null for none.

observed_from.title: Observed From
observed_from.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day a snapshot of eerstekamer.nl first showed it (not the day it began: the site gives no start as data); null for the Tweede Kamer.

observed_until.title: Observed Until
observed_until.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day of the first snapshot that no longer showed it (not the day it ended); null while it is shown.

periods.title: Periods
periods.description: Every seat on it, oldest first, when there was more than one or it has a role; the fields above are the one that represents them (an open seat before a closed one, a member's before a substitute's, the latest).

MemberCommitteeDTO.title: MemberCommitteeDTO
MemberCommitteeDTO.description: A committee a member sat on, and their seat on it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name they go by: ``Ard van der Steur`` (``Persoon.Roepnaam``); for a minister who never sat in parliament, as Rijksoverheid gives it.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: ``Gerard Adriaan van der Steur``; null when the TK gives none.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: A stable name for a readable URL: ``rob-jetten``; a namesake who came later has the year they were born (``jan-de-vries-1971``), else their number of the Tweede Kamer. Never changes once given. ``/api/members?slug=`` and ``/api/lookup?kind=member`` find the member by it.

family_name.title: Family Name
family_name.description: The surname without its tussenvoegsel, as the TK gives it (``Persoon.Achternaam``): ``Steur``. A list sorted by surname (``sort=family_name``) sorts on it, then on ``name_prefix``.

name_prefix.title: Name Prefix
name_prefix.description: The tussenvoegsel, as the TK gives it (``Persoon.Tussenvoegsel``): ``van der``; null for none.

ek_faction_memberships.title: Ek Faction Memberships
ek_faction_memberships.description: Their periods in the factions of the Eerste Kamer, the current first, as their page on eerstekamer.nl says them; empty for none read.

government_functions.title: Government Functions
government_functions.description: The posts held in a cabinet (from Rijksoverheid), oldest first.

ek.description: Their seat in the Eerste Kamer; null for none ever observed.

role.title: Role
role.description: In a committee: the role of the seat as the Kamer writes it, of the Tweede Kamer its ``Functie`` (``Lid``, ``Voorzitter``, ``OnderVz``, ``PlvLid``), of the Eerste Kamer the role its page gives (``voorzitter``, ``ondervoorzitter``).

observed_from.title: Observed From
observed_from.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day a snapshot of eerstekamer.nl first showed it (not the day it began: the site gives no start as data); null for the Tweede Kamer.

observed_until.title: Observed Until
observed_until.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day of the first snapshot that no longer showed it (not the day it ended); null while it is shown.

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: The last day, inclusive (the Kamer's TotEnMet); null while open.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

MemberDTO.title: MemberDTO
MemberDTO.description:
A member of parliament or a minister.

``active`` means they hold an open faction membership — currently seated.
``party`` comes from that same membership, so the two always agree.

``from_date`` / ``to_date`` are only filled when the member is returned
as part of a committee, where they carry that committee seat's period.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name they go by: ``Ard van der Steur`` (``Persoon.Roepnaam``); for a minister who never sat in parliament, as Rijksoverheid gives it.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: ``Gerard Adriaan van der Steur``; null when the TK gives none.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: A stable name for a readable URL: ``rob-jetten``; a namesake who came later has the year they were born (``jan-de-vries-1971``), else their number of the Tweede Kamer. Never changes once given. ``/api/members?slug=`` and ``/api/lookup?kind=member`` find the member by it.

family_name.title: Family Name
family_name.description: The surname without its tussenvoegsel, as the TK gives it (``Persoon.Achternaam``): ``Steur``. A list sorted by surname (``sort=family_name``) sorts on it, then on ``name_prefix``.

name_prefix.title: Name Prefix
name_prefix.description: The tussenvoegsel, as the TK gives it (``Persoon.Tussenvoegsel``): ``van der``; null for none.

ek_faction_memberships.title: Ek Faction Memberships
ek_faction_memberships.description: Their periods in the factions of the Eerste Kamer, the current first, as their page on eerstekamer.nl says them; empty for none read.

government_functions.title: Government Functions
government_functions.description: The posts held in a cabinet (from Rijksoverheid), oldest first.

ek.description: Their seat in the Eerste Kamer; null for none ever observed.

role.title: Role
role.description: In a committee: the role of the seat as the Kamer writes it, of the Tweede Kamer its ``Functie`` (``Lid``, ``Voorzitter``, ``OnderVz``, ``PlvLid``), of the Eerste Kamer the role its page gives (``voorzitter``, ``ondervoorzitter``).

observed_from.title: Observed From
observed_from.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day a snapshot of eerstekamer.nl first showed it (not the day it began: the site gives no start as data); null for the Tweede Kamer.

observed_until.title: Observed Until
observed_until.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the day of the first snapshot that no longer showed it (not the day it ended); null while it is shown.

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: The last day, inclusive (the Kamer's TotEnMet); null while open.

death_date.title: Death Date
death_date.description: The day they died, as the TK gives it (``Overlijdensdatum``).

has_role.title: Has Role
has_role.description: Whether the sources give them a role: a seat in a faction of either chamber or a post in a cabinet. False for a person of the TK's records whose seat the data does not hold: their page is not indexed and search lists them last.

government_name.title: Government Name
government_name.description: The name as Rijksoverheid writes it: S.Th.M. Hermans.

committees.title: Committees
committees.description: The committees they sat on, of either chamber, with their seat and role: those they sit on now first, then by name.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

MemberDetailDTO.title: MemberDetailDTO
MemberDetailDTO.description:
A member with the posts they held in government.

``government_functions`` come from Rijksoverheid (every post in a cabinet since 1945),
oldest first; empty for a member who held none. A bewindspersoon is matched to a member
of parliament by surname, initials and age, a minister who never sat in parliament by
the papers they signed; one the Tweede Kamer has no person for is a member of their own
(key ``rijksoverheid_<initials>_<surname>``).

total.title: Total
total.description: Every paper the member signed.

next_offset.title: Next Offset
next_offset.description: The ``offset`` of the next page; null on the last.

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: TK Besluit identifier of the decision.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: The vote as the source wrote it: Voor, Tegen, Onthouden, …

seats.title: Seats
seats.description: Seats behind this vote; 1 on a roll-call.

party.title: Party
party.description: The party of the faction they sat in on ``date``; of their own vote on an undated decision the one they sit for now.

faction_key.title: Faction Key
faction_key.description: The faction they sat in on ``date``, also of their own vote; null where no period of theirs holds the day.

vote_source.title: Vote Source
vote_source.description: ``member``: their own vote, on a roll-call (hoofdelijke stemming); ``faction``: their faction's, cast while they belonged to it.

in_office.title: In Office
in_office.description: The posts in a cabinet (``government_functions``) the member held on ``date``, oldest first: a vote as (demissionary) bewindspersoon and Kamerlid; empty when none.

coalition.description: Of the Tweede Kamer: what the coalition of the cabinet in office did, as ``GET /api/decisions/{key}`` gives it; null without a cabinet or a coalition vote, and of the Eerste Kamer.

coalition_factions.title: Coalition Factions
coalition_factions.description: Each coalition faction that cast a seat, with its choice, most seats first (as on the feed); empty where ``coalition`` is null.

MemberVoteDTO.title: MemberVoteDTO
MemberVoteDTO.description:
One vote a member took part in.

``party`` is the party they sat for on ``date``, which may differ from
the party they sit for now.

count.title: Count
count.description: Votes returned; may be fewer than the total.

next_offset.title: Next Offset
next_offset.description: The ``offset`` of the next page; null when this page was not full (the last one).

MinistryDTO.title: MinistryDTO
MinistryDTO.description:
A ministry name of ``data/ministries.json``: a name that came back (Economische
Zaken) has a period for each time; a former one names its successor and the last day
it had its name (``successor`` and ``until`` of its last period).

from_date.title: From Date
from_date.description: Null where no source dates it.

until.title: Until
until.description: The last day; null while it has the name, or where unknown.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: The Staatscourant decree the end rests on (from TOOI).

source.title: Source
source.description: ``tooi`` (the TOOI value list, since about 2010) or ``rijksoverheid`` (the first post and a handover on the cabinet pages).

successor_source.title: Successor Source
successor_source.description: ``curated`` for a succession no source gives (before 2010; ``data/curated/ministries.json``).

MinistryPeriodDTO.title: MinistryPeriodDTO
MinistryPeriodDTO.description: A stretch in which the ministry had its name, and where that is known from.

lid_counts.title: Lid Counts
lid_counts.description: Of an article: per lid the edges of the whole bucket cite, how many do ("" for those that cite none; an edge that cites two counts for each); null when none of them cites a lid.

capacity_counts.title: Capacity Counts
capacity_counts.description: Of a member's ``AUTHORED`` (outbound): per capacity they signed in (``meta.capacity``: ``kamerlid``, ``bewindspersoon``, ``overig``; "" for none), how many of the whole bucket, not only of its page. Null for every other bucket, with a ``status`` filter, and before the signatures are kept with their capacity.

NeighborBucketDTO.title: NeighborBucketDTO
NeighborBucketDTO.description: The neighbours that share a relation, a direction and a collection: one page of them.

kind_group.title: Kind Group
kind_group.description: Of a paper or a case: What the paper or case is, by its Soort (`kind`): `motie` or `amendement` (also a changed one), `wetsvoorstel`, `brief` (a Soort beginning with Brief), `overig`; null without a Soort. Absent for any other node.

cite.description: Of a judgment: The judgment as a lawyer cites it: `short` `HR 20 december 2019`, `Rb. Den Haag 6 december 2019`, `Conclusie A-G Hartlief 20 december 2019` (`P-G` where a procureur-generaal signed it), `HvJ EU 22 juni 2023, C-160/20` (a court of the Union with its case number); `full` with its ECLI. Null without an ECLI. Absent for a node of another collection.

title.title: Title
title.description: Its title, as the `<title>` of its page has it and `title` of `/api/nodes/{collection}/{key}` (`Art. 6:162 BW, Onrechtmatige daad`, `HR 20 december 2019 (Urgenda), ECLI:NL:HR:2019:2006`, `36496 Wet AI-toezicht`), from the props it carries (with `props=canvas` too, which keeps what it reads).

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a source without one, or when the answer lacks what makes it.

NeighborDTO.title: NeighborDTO
NeighborDTO.description: A neighbour with the edge that leads to it, used by the generic node explorer.

total.title: Total
total.description: Its neighbours there along the edges walked, of the types asked (from the edges: one that is gone counts too).

NeighborhoodCollectionDTO.title: NeighborhoodCollectionDTO
NeighborhoodCollectionDTO.description:
Of the focal node's own neighbours in one collection: how many, and how many the
neighbourhood holds under its cap.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: ``Activiteit.Soort``: ``Commissiedebat``, ``Plenair debat``, ``Stemmingen``, …

committee.description: Its lead committee (``key``, ``slug``, ``name``, ``path``); null in plenary.

NextActivityDTO.title: NextActivityDTO
NextActivityDTO.description: An activity the Tweede Kamer has planned.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the node as its page has it (``Artikel 6:162 BW: onrechtmatige daad``), without the name of the site.

path.title: Path
path.description: Its readable address (``/wetten/BWBR0005289/artikel/6:162``); null for a node without one.

lid_counts_pending.title: Lid Counts Pending
lid_counts_pending.description: Of an article asked with ``limit=1``: its lid counts are being counted, so every ``lid_counts`` is null; a request with a larger ``limit`` waits for them and has them. False otherwise.

passages.title: Passages
passages.description: With `edge_meta=passages`: where a judgment cites the article or the judgment the edge reaches (absent otherwise, and for an edge without them).

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: The `meta` of the edge as a neighbour's edge has it (without the places a judgment cites; with `props=canvas` only the keys the canvas reads), without `passages`: the period of a membership (`from_date`, `to_date`), the posts, the lid cited. Null for an edge without one.

buckets.title: Buckets
buckets.description: Per collection of the focal node's own neighbours (the first level), by name: `total` and `kept`; where `kept` is less, the cap left the rest out (`GET /api/nodes/{collection}/{key}` lists them all).

NodeNeighborhoodResponse.title: NodeNeighborhoodResponse
NodeNeighborhoodResponse.description: One-shot N-hop neighborhood: focal + reachable nodes + spanning edges.

law_id.title: Law Id
law_id.description: The BWB or CELEX id of its law; null when the citation names no law.

number.title: Number
number.description: The number as the article is stored: `162` of `6:162 BW` (in the book's own regulation), `3:4` of the Awb.

NotationDTO.title: NotationDTO
NotationDTO.description:
What `q` is as a notation: an identifier or a citation, taken apart. There with a
match and without one: a citation that names nothing in the graph is still one.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Of an `ecli`, `bwb`, `celex` or `commitment`: the identifier, upper case; of a `publication` its id at officielebekendmakingen.nl (`stb-2026-94`, `stcrt-2026-12345`, `trb-2018-201`).

dossier_number.title: Dossier Number
dossier_number.description: Of a `dossier` or `document`: the dossier number (`36327`).

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: Of a `document`: its number in the dossier (`3`), or the letter of a paper of the Eerste Kamer (`A`).

articles.title: Articles
articles.description: Of an `article`: the articles it names.

qualifier.title: Qualifier
qualifier.description: Of an `article`: the lid or onder it names (`derde lid`).

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: Of an `article`: the articles are those the citation may mean, not all of them (`art. 3 BW`: article 3 of every book).

NotationPartsDTO.title: NotationPartsDTO
NotationPartsDTO.description: What a notation is made of; null or empty what it does not name.

PaperRefDTO.title: PaperRefDTO
PaperRefDTO.description: Another paper, by its id and its number in its dossier.

cabinet.title: Cabinet
cabinet.description: The cabinet in office on `as_of` (`key`, `name`), whose coalition `coalition` marks; null when none was.

seating_plan.description: The plan of the Tweede Kamer the order of `factions` follows; null for the Eerste Kamer, whose factions are in the order of their seats.

source.description: Of the Eerste Kamer: the page the seats were read from.
